segments.intent: on 'What if I told you': the 'Bakery Image Prompt' chat with the Ghibli bakery picture filling the screen, zoomed; on 'toolbar': click the picture so the image editor opens, then zoom on the top bar (Markup, Comment, Remove BG, Erase, Resize); on 'never even clicked it': the cursor rests on Markup; on '10%': ease out to the picture in the editor; on 'real magic lives': slow zoom on the baker and the Panetteria sign; on 'comment pins': the cursor on Comment; on 'cutouts': the cursor on Remove BG; on 'the whole toolbar': the full top bar; on 'every prompt on screen': close the editor, then show the whole message box zoomed out with a short prompt pasted in whole, not sent; on 'free on every plan': cut to https://chatgpt.com/pricing, top of the page unzoomed with the ChatGPT logo; on 'daily cap for free users': cut to the Free plan card, zoomed on 'Limited image creation'. No other plans.

on 'this one': the bakery picture open in the image editor, zoom on the top toolbar; on 'image inside of ChatGPT': ease out to the picture with its toolbar; on 'make sure': close the editor and show the ChatGPT start screen unzoomed, ChatGPT logo and left sidebar visible, no popups; on 'image option': zoom on 'Images' in the left sidebar; on 'updated': tighter zoom on the label next to 'Images'; on 'ChatGPT images 2.5': click Images, and the Images page with the 'Describe a new image' box appears; on 'start generating': the whole box, zoomed out, with 'a cup of coffee on a wooden table' pasted in whole; on 'anything': click the round blue arrow; on 'loading part': the new chat with the generating card; on 'percentage counter': zoom on the progress percentage; on '40%, then 65': hold as it climbs; on 'older model': stay on the forming image; on 'given up on you': the finished image appears.

on 'drag it straight into a normal chat': a new chat with the hot sauce photo attached as a thumbnail above the message box, zoomed out; on 'that image is in the chat': the photo in the chat thread; on 'toolbar comes up': click the photo so the editor opens, then zoom on the top bar; on 'Markup, Comment, Erase': the cursor moves along those buttons; on 'Remove Background, Resize': the cursor reaches Remove BG, then Resize; on 'limits': cut to https://chatgpt.com/pricing, top of the page unzoomed with the ChatGPT logo, no cookie banner; on 'free plan': cut to the Free plan card zoomed on 'Limited image creation'; on 'ChatGPT+': cut to the Plus card zoomed on 'More complex and accurate image creation'; on '40 to 50': hold there. Never all the prices at once.

on 'Open up Sketch': the hot sauce photo in the editor, zoom on the top toolbar; on 'click Sketch': the cursor on the Sketch button; on 'at symbol right in the message box': cut to a new chat, message box zoomed out; on 'at Sketch': '@Sketch' is typed and picked from the pop-up, the pop-up closes; on 'blank canvas comes up': the blank sketch canvas fills the screen; on 'squat bottle in the middle': a simple bottle is drawn in the middle; on 'picnic table': table lines under it; on 'wonky sun': a sun in the top right corner; on 'chili pepper with a face': a pepper with a face; on 'look at that': the finished doodle; on 'check mark': click the check mark; on 'type the prompt': the whole message box, zoomed out, with 'Turn this rough sketch into a realistic photo, a glass squat hot sauce bottle on a weathered wooden picnic table, warm late afternoon light, shallow depth of field' pasted in whole; on 'hit send': click the blue arrow; on 'here's the photo': dissolve to the finished photo; on 'the glass': zoom on the bottle; on 'the light': ease to the lit table; on 'where everything sits': the full photo; on 'my little pepper': zoom on the pepper; on 'real table': ease out to the full photo.

on 'open up the image': in the same chat, click the photo made from the sketch so the editor opens; on 'markup tool': click Markup; on 'drag a box over the blank front of the label': a box is dragged over the front of the label; on 'type the change': the box's text field with 'Add a small chili pepper illustration right here' pasted whole; on 'hit send': click send; on 'there it is': dissolve to the edited photo; on 'sitting on the label': zoom on the label; on 'everything around it': ease out to the full photo; on 'Nothing shifted': hold.

on 'click the comment feature': the latest photo in the editor, click Comment; on 'part of the photo': the cursor moves over the photo; on 'first pin, I'll put it on the label': a pin drops on the label; on 'little box opens up': zoom on the note box; on 'type your note': 'Make this label look aged and slightly water stained' pasted whole; on 'Don't send it yet': hold, cursor away from send; on 'second pin here on the sun': a pin on the sun with 'Drop the sun lower, golden hour' pasted whole; on 'third pin on the chili pepper': a pin on the pepper with a short note; on 'three pins': ease out to all three pins; on 'hit send': click send; on 'Look at that': dissolve to the result; on 'label's gone soft': zoom on the label; on 'sun's sitting lower': cut to the sun and warm sky; on 'peppers got char': zoom on the pepper; on 'agree with each other': the full photo; on 'lands on the label': zoom on the label; on 'pepper too': cut to the pepper; on 'OpenAI': the full photo; on 'Change only what you want': zoom on the label; on 'keep the rest': ease out to the full photo.

on 'Three separate prompts': the chat thread on the single sent message with the three pinned notes, zoomed out; on 'one send, one result': the result photo in the thread, zoomed; on 'erase something': click the photo so the editor opens; on 'stray napkin': zoom on the napkin next to the bottle; on 'click the erase feature': click Erase; on 'highlight the napkin': brush over the napkin; on 'send button': click send; on 'look at that': dissolve to the result; on 'part of the napkin': zoom on what is left of the napkin; on 'wood grain': zoom on the wood behind it; on 'patch that doesn't match': hold on the patch; on 'bit of napkin': zoom on the corner of the selection.

on 'Here's the bottle again': the bottle photo on the wooden table in the editor; on 'remove background': click Remove BG; on 'One click': hold; on 'there it is': dissolve to the bottle on plain white; on 'shop listing': hold on the cutout; on 'zoom in on the edge of the glass': zoom on the glass edge; on 'it holds up': hold; on 'The outline': slow push along the outline; on 'judge the edge': hold; on 'resize feature': click Resize; on 'pick the shape': the shape menu zoomed (Square 1:1, Portrait 3:4, Story 9:16, Landscape 4:3, Widescreen 16:9); on 'need': click Story 9:16; on 'check that out': dissolve to the tall version; on 'story instead of a feed': hold on the tall image.

on 'click on templates': the Images page, click the Templates tab; on 'here's the list': the template list, zoomed; on 'posters, logos': the cursor moves over a poster tile, then a logo tile; on 'pick the shape': hold on the logo tile; on 'logo template': zoom on the logo template; on 'poster template': cut to a poster template; on 'grab the logo one': click the logo template; on 'wants a name': zoom on the box asking for a name; on 'grandma's regret': 'Grandma's Regret' pasted whole; on 'hit enter': press enter; on 'you've got a logo': dissolve to the finished logo; on 'lettering': zoom on the lettering; on 'one name': ease out to the full logo.

on 'Upload the photo': a new chat with the hot sauce photo attached above the message box, zoomed out; on 'one short instruction': 'Put this bottle on a sunny cafe table' pasted whole into the box; on 'hit send': click the blue arrow; on 'run the exact same prompt again': the result in the thread, then the same prompt pasted again, zoomed out; on 'three times through': click send; on 'no four at once': hold on the single result; on 'again and again': dissolve to the reruns stacked in the thread; on 'landed the best': zoom on the best of them.

Every prompt is pasted whole into the message box, shown zoomed out, never sent, one calm beat each. On 'upscale it photorealistically': 'Upscale this photo photorealistically'; on 'Remove the man': 'Remove the man'; on 'Grand Canyon': 'Bring me into the Grand Canyon'; on 'Ghibli style': 'Make this look Ghibli style'; on 'Anime, cartoon': 'Make this look anime style'; on 'claymation': 'Make this look claymation style'; on 'restore this old photo': 'Restore this old photo, but preserve the people'; on 'Colorizing': 'Colorize this black and white photo, keep it subtle'; on 'stunning portrait': 'Turn this into a stunning portrait'; on 'shallow depth of field': 'Create a shallow depth of field effect. Sharp subject, soft background.'; on 'Don't ask for a blurred background': zoom on 'Sharp subject, soft background'; on 'phrasing that lands': hold on that line; on 'told it what you wanted': ease out to the whole box.

on 'typing a forward slash': a new chat, message box zoomed out, '/' typed and the menu that opens; on 'background skill': the cursor on the background option in that menu; on 'just the detail': the menu closes, the box zoomed out; on 'rustic kitchen background': 'rustic kitchen background' pasted whole after the command; on 'add object': the box cleared and the add object command in the box; on 'olive tree besides the sofa': 'a large indoor olive tree beside the sofa' pasted whole; on 'pays for itself': hold on the whole box. Nothing is sent.

on 'the real test': a new chat, message box zoomed out; on 'real photo of a real bottle': the hot sauce bottle photo attached above the box, zoomed; on 'upload that photo straight into the chat': ease out to the box with the photo; on 'The prompt': 'Use this exact bottle, put it on a rustic kitchen counter beside fresh chilies, morning light through the window' pasted whole, zoomed out; on 'hit send': click the blue arrow; on 'there it is': dissolve to the result; on 'new counter': zoom on the counter; on 'new light': ease to the window light; on 'chilies': zoom on the chilies; on 'the product didn't': zoom on the bottle; on 'GPT Images 2.5': the full result; on 'consistent across several edits': scroll up the thread to the earlier bottle edits, zoomed; on 'change the background': back to the newest result; on 'same bottle in every shot': zoom on the bottle; on 'one photo': ease out to the full result; on 'a label with words on it': zoom on the label; on 'zoom into both': tighter on the label; on 'still readable': hold on the label text.
